descriptions.value: Buffer over-read in PostgreSQL parallel B-tree scans allows an object creator to read attacker-chosen server-memory addresses, via a function incorrectly marked PARALLEL SAFE or STABLE to make participating workers build different scan-key arrays.  Within major versions 17-18, minor versions before PostgreSQL 18.7 and 17.12 are affected.  Versions before PostgreSQL 17 are unaffected.

assertions.title: PostgreSQL parallel B-tree array scan reads beyond array bounds

title: PostgreSQL parallel B-tree array scan reads beyond array bounds

descriptions.value: In GetTwiddledMiptreeSparsePageMap of texmgmt.c, there is a possible way to trigger an out of bounds write due to a logic error. This could lead to remote code execution with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.
